risk_note: RV2 by path (admin module): orchestrator ruling D10-238. The admin TOTP verifier (admin/domain/totp.ts createTotpVerifier) now collects every matching step in the ±1 window and calls replay.consume in ascending step order; the first true accepts, only a false moves on, a thrown error propagates at once (fail closed); all refused means replay. Format check, decryption, constant-time comparison of every window step and zeroing the key are unchanged; the replay store (totp_last_step, monotonic) is unchanged, so each step is still used once and steps before an accepted one count as used. When adjacent steps share a code (about one in a million), the same code string can be accepted once per step (per-step replay protection, the trade-off D10-238 accepted). Login, first binding, step-up and verify-super share the verifier. No contract, schema or money path. Rule tests (24, [AC-B1-34l#n]) by an independent Claude (approvals #36, Codex out of quota), collision fixture computed offline by the orchestrator and re-checked in the tests with an independent HMAC; red before the implementation; implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent in one run.
